name: Things That Saw It
nameStatus: working name; final name and handle to be chosen before the channel is created
niche: Short 2D animated life stories (2-5 min), each told by an everyday object that watched one person's turning point
audience: English-speaking adults 18-44 who watch emotional animated shorts and self-improvement stories; US, UK, Canada, Australia

brand.look: Warm storybook paintings drawn in code: soft window light, dust, grain, objects as the heroes. No faceless black-silhouette people (that is Last Soul's look).

voices._note: One narrator voice per object, chosen per film. Not chosen yet; no paid requests made.
